# Set B — original timed practice,20marks
Suggested50minutes:5reading,40working,5checking.8short/12extendedmarks. Different emphasis from SetA; not equivalent difficulty or a validated score-comparison instrument. Paper first; reference answers later. Formative inside Week16lesson1.
B1 (4): Given RoomSession.remaining initially1 and reserve implemented as `if self.remaining < 0: raise ValueError("Full")` then `self.remaining -= 1`; OnlineSession inherits and overrides location->"Online", RoomSession.location->"Room". State output of a location-call loop on one of each(1), explain polymorphic dispatch(1), repair the reservation condition(1), specify test exposing the original fault and expected corrected behaviour(1).
B2 (4): A report INNERJOINs Resource to Loan and usesCOUNT(*). Requirement is ALL resources, total loans and active loans (actual Loan row withNULL ReturnDate). Identify missing-zero-row fault(1), repair join/link(1), explain active count avoiding outer placeholder(1), predict total/active pairs(1). SQL expression allowed:COUNT(CASE WHEN l.ReturnDate IS NULL THEN l.LoanID END).
B3 (6): Write summarise(rows)->dictionary accumulating exact topic counts. Criteria: initialise/iterate/unpack(1), enforce topic non-empty string(1), enforce non-negative exact integer excludingbool(1), repeated/first-key accumulation(1), return correct mapping including empty list(1), meaningful repeated/zero/invalid tests with expected outcomes(1). Do not mutate input. Contract assumes each row is a pair; no live input interface required.
B4 (6): A flat loan sheet containsLoanID,ResourceID,ResourceLabel,CategoryID,CategoryName,MemberID,MemberName,StartDate,ReturnDate. Dependencies:LoanID->ResourceID,MemberID,dates;ResourceID->Label,CategoryID;CategoryID->Name;MemberID->Name. Explain two transitive dependencies(2), decompose intoCategory/Resource/Member/Loan with PK/FKs(1), justifyLoanID rather thanResourceID+MemberID for repeated events and relationships(1), explain explicit rollback after a second-step domain error(1), and justify retention/recovery decisions with needed evidence rather than automatic deletion(1). Inspection is separately supplied; doesn't arise from this flat sheet.
Use command and source facts precisely. Record uncertainty, then mark/explain/retry with changed data.
